title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds steady at $64,030 as Fear & Greed sinks to 27, keeping sentiment in fear territory despite the flat US session. Network hashrate sits at 781 EH/s, confirming strong miner commitment. Mempool backlog hits 106,909 transactions with fees at just 6 sat/vB, pointing to light fee pressure amid congestion. Block height reaches 958,439. No fresh catalysts in morning trade.
